company.name: Nectome
company.shortDescription: Nectome is a neuroscience startup that aims to preserve the brain and keep all its memories intact.
company.description:
Nectome is a neuroscience startup that aims to preserve the brain and keep all its memories intact.

The company is building the next generation of tools to preserve the connectome. The connectome is all the connections called synapses between neurons in the brain. Researchers from the company is now learning to manipulate individual memories, building advanced brain prosthetics, and reverse-engineering the brain.

productsAndServices.description: A technique to preserve the entire mammalian connectome by vitrification, maintaining neural structure for long-term study.
productsAndServices.name: Connectome Preservation

productsAndServices.description: In silico modeling of vitrification and fixation processes to understand and optimize preservation at the molecular level.
productsAndServices.name: Molecular Dynamics

productsAndServices.description: Research focused on developing methods to extract information correlates of memory from chemically preserved neural tissue.
productsAndServices.name: Memory Extraction

productsAndServices.description: Verification and study of the preservation quality of proteins, nucleic acids, lipids, and other biomolecules in fixed brain tissue.
productsAndServices.name: Biomolecular Preservation
